definition: OAuth is an open standard for access delegation, commonly used as a way for Internet users to grant websites or applications access to their information on other websites but without giving them the passwords (e.g., 'Log in with Google'). In Express, this is usually implemented via Passport.js.

answers.answer: OAuth is an open standard for access delegation, commonly used as a way for Internet users to grant websites or applications access to their information on other websites but without giving them the passwords (e.g., 'Log in with Google').

answers.question: When should you avoid using OAuth Authentication?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
